metadata.name: Requirement Extractor Stress Validation Dataset
metadata.scope: Current 13-field Lustre user-requirement extraction, normalization, validation, clarification and multi-turn state management.

default_evaluation_mode.note: The first baseline must be deterministic. Hybrid/LLM evaluation can be run separately on the same cases.

schema_notes.fields: Expected cumulative non-null plain_final_json values after the turn.
schema_notes.missing_fields: Required fields expected to remain missing after the turn.
schema_notes.conflicting_fields: Fields expected to be unresolved because several supported values conflict.
schema_notes.invalid_fields: Fields expected to be rejected by deterministic validation.
schema_notes.unsupported_fields: Extracted fields expected to be rejected because textual evidence is insufficient.
schema_notes.question_field: Field that the first clarification question should target.
schema_notes.must_not_extract: Fields that must remain null to measure hallucination/over-extraction.
schema_notes.calculation: Expected calculation readiness and selected deterministic outputs when the case is complete.
